findings.title: Gate 5 Supervisor PASS does not bind the target, and FF-CLAUDE-V3-003 (MEDIUM) is still recorded 'NOT YET CLOSED' in the target tree
findings.evidence_ref: docs/vnext/supervision/FOUNDATION_V3_GROK_SUPERVISOR_DISPOSITION_V1_20261008.md ('subject to the packet/result binding above remaining unchanged'; 'modifying the supervised target would invalidate this supervision pass'; 'Do not mutate PR #322 solely to close these LOW findings before rereview'); docs/vnext/red_team/FOUNDATION_FREEZE_CLAUDE_V3_DISPOSITION_20261008.md section FF-CLAUDE-V3-003 ('ROOT CAUSE ACCEPTED; NOT YET CLOSED'; closure requires inspection of 'this repair candidate'); tests/test_master_blueprint_v1.py::test_supervisor_gap_is_explicitly_held_not_waived pins 'NOT YET CLOSED'; git diff 9bd3214..c3f7cbe = 20 files, including MASTER_BLUEPRINT (blob 2a00bda→e410a3c), CAPABILITY_TRUTH_MATRIX, DEBT_REGISTER, FOUNDATION_CLOSURE decision, OPENAI_V2_DISPOSITION, both handoffs, state/current.yaml, state/tasks.yaml and tests; packet and plan list only V4-001/V4-007 as historical material findings and call the Supervisor PASS 'historical … for 9bd3214 only'.
findings.defect: The only Supervisor inspection (SUPERVISION_PASS) covers 9bd3214. The target mutates that supervised tree in normative and state files, which the Supervisor disposition itself says invalidates the pass. The one MEDIUM whose closure condition is a Supervisor inspection of the repair candidate therefore has no inspection bound to the target, while the target's own disposition (test-pinned) still says it is not closed. Neither the packet nor the plan lists V3-003 as an open material item. I read the 9bd3214..c3f7cbe delta line by line and found no content defect in it; the gap is the lifecycle gate (SUPERVISE before review/acceptance), not the delta's content. An independent critic does not substitute for the Supervisor role under the Law.
findings.repair: Either (a) a fresh different-seat Supervisor inspection bound to the final exact head, or at minimum to the 9bd3214..c3f7cbe delta, followed by a new exact-head review if any tree change results; or (b) an explicit Owner disposition under the Law, quoted in the final acceptance record without altering the reviewed tree, stating that the 9bd3214 Supervisor PASS plus independent V5R4 review of the delta satisfies Gate 5 and that FF-CLAUDE-V3-003 is closed. In either case list V3-003 as a material finding in the packet or acceptance record.

findings.title: New tests are brittle and one is not portable to Windows checkouts
findings.evidence_ref: tests/test_master_blueprint_v1.py: test_grok_v4_intake_is_historical_not_v5_acceptance hashes working-tree bytes as a git blob (hashlib.sha1('blob N\0' + raw)); no .gitattributes exists at the target. Also pins phase == FOUNDATION_V4_INTEGRATED_EXACT_HEAD_REVIEW_GATE, 'MATERIAL_FINDINGS_PRESENT_V4', 'FF-CLAUDE-V4-001/007 MEDIUM' and 'NOT YET CLOSED'.
findings.defect: With core.autocrlf=true on Windows (the repo ships ops/windows and .bat files) the multi-line JSON would be checked out as CRLF and the blob-SHA assertion would fail locally while Linux CI passes. The string pins mean the matrix, debt register, state and V3 disposition cannot record a clean post-review truth without editing tests.
findings.repair: Add .gitattributes with `docs/vnext/red_team/*.json text eol=lf` (or hash via `git cat-file`), and replace phase/status string pins with gate-state assertions in the canonicalization PR.
